Solid molar heat capacity 236.6 J/(mol.K) is an explicit editorial estimate by Kopp's rule from the additive contributions C 10.89, H 7.56, O 13.42 J/(mol.K), not a measurement. The substance modelled is D-glucose in its pyranose ring form, and the physical properties above are D-glucose's. The curated SMILES and official-library InChIKey carry the D configuration while deliberately leaving the anomeric centre unspecified, so identity distinguishes D- from L-glucose without pretending to choose the alpha or beta anomer.
